
# Getting Started {.unnumbered}


# 
This part will help you understand what RHESSys can do, decide whether it is a good fit for your project, and begin preparing for a RHESSys modeling project. Along the way, you will:

-   Become familiar with the overall workflow of a RHESSys modeling project, and with some key concepts and terminology
-   Learn how to set up your modeling environment, consider important aspects of project design, and explore the example dataset

By the end of this part, you will have a foundation for moving forward with your own RHESSys modeling project.
